case_title: TYLER MORRIS VS. GOLDEN GATEWAY CENTER SPE, LLC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-25-2024 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MORRIS, TYLER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GOLDEN GATEWAY CENTER SPE, LLC $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,090.00, PLAINTIFF PROVIDED SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT HIS CLAIM THAT DEFENDANT DID NOT EXERCISE ORDINARY CARE TO AVOID AN UNREASONABLE RISK OF HARM, RESULTING IN HIS CARGO BIKE BEING STOLEN. HE PROVIDED EVIDENCE THAT SHOWED HE SUFFERED OVER 10,000.00 IN DAMAGES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
